title: 第67章 个体户和铁饭碗
content_zh:
第67章 个体户和铁饭碗-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

孙建民笑容僵了一瞬。

这话听着像是说自己愿意干个体户。

但仔细咂摸，“受不了管”、“看不惯弯弯绕绕”，怎么听怎么像是说他们这些吃公家饭的。

关键是林国强说这话的时候笑呵呵的，一脸实诚，让人挑不出毛病。

赵素芳还想说什么，林国强放下酒杯，从椅子上拎起一个布包。

“爸，给您带了两条烟。”

他把两条过滤嘴香烟放在桌上，“您抽抽这个，比旱烟顺嗓子。”

赵德厚接过来，看了看牌子，眼睛亮了：“过滤嘴的？这个可不便宜。”

“孝敬您的，不心疼钱。”

林国强又指着那两瓶洋河大曲：“这个酒您留着，慢慢喝。”

赵德厚笑得合不拢嘴。

孙建民脸色有点僵。

他带来的东西就是几斤苹果，加起来不到两块钱。

刘胜利那两斤糕点，虽然是供销社的，但也值不了几个钱。

林国强这两条过滤嘴香烟加两瓶洋河大曲，少说十来块。

林国强又从布包里拿出一块布料。

淡蓝色的的确良，叠得整整齐齐。

“妈，这是给您的。”他把布料递给王桂兰，“您做件褂子穿。”

王桂兰接过来，摸了摸，眼睛都亮了：“这颜色真好看。

素梅你瞅瞅，多鲜亮。”

赵素梅笑着说：“国强挑的，他说您穿蓝色好看。”

王桂兰喜得合不拢嘴，当场就往身上比划。

赵素芳和赵素英对视一眼，脸色都有些不好看。

她们回来，带的是水果糕点。

林国强回来，带的是烟酒布料。

这差距，一眼就看出来了。

“对了。”林国强又开口了，“还有件事。”

桌上的人都看着他。

“志军在我店里干得不错。”

林国强看向坐在桌尾的赵志军，“肯学，肯干，不偷懒。

下个月开始，工钱涨到四十块。”

赵志军筷子都掉了。

“四……四十？”

“嗯。”林国强点头，“你现在能独当一面了，揉面、卤肉、看火候，都不用我盯着。

值这个价。”

赵志军腾地站起来，脸涨得通红：“三姐夫，我......”

Sun Jianmin's smile froze for a moment.

This sounds like he is willing to be self-employed.

But if you look carefully, "I can't stand the control" and "I can't stand the twists and turns", it sounds like they are talking about people who are eating from the government.

The key is that Lin Guoqiang smiled when he said this, with an honest look on his face, making it impossible for anyone to find fault.

Zhao Sufang wanted to say something else, but Lin Guoqiang put down his wine glass and picked up a cloth bag from the chair.

"Dad, I brought you two cigarettes."

He put two filter-tipped cigarettes on the table, "If you smoke this, it will go smoother on your throat than dry cigarettes."

Zhao Dehou took it and looked at the brand, his eyes lit up: "Filter? This is not cheap."

"Those who respect you don't care about money."

Lin Guoqiang pointed to the two bottles of Yanghe Daqu again: "You can keep this wine and drink it slowly."

Zhao Dehou smiled from ear to ear.

Sun Jianmin's face was a little stiff.

What he brought was just a few kilograms of apples, which cost less than two yuan in total.

Although Liu Shengli's two kilograms of cakes were from the supply and marketing cooperative, they were not worth much.

Lin Guoqiang's two filter cigarettes plus two bottles of Yanghe Daqu cost about ten yuan at least.

Lin Guoqiang took out another piece of cloth from the cloth bag.

The light blue ones are neatly folded.

"Mom, this is for you." He handed the fabric to Wang Guilan, "You can make a coat to wear."

Wang Guilan took it and touched it, her eyes lit up: "The color is so beautiful.

Sumei, take a look, how bright it is."

Zhao Sumei smiled and said, "Guo Qiang picked it. He said you look good in blue."

Wang Guilan was so happy that she started gesticulating on her body on the spot.

Zhao Sufang and Zhao Suying looked at each other with ugly expressions on their faces.

They came back with fruit cakes.

Lin Guoqiang came back with tobacco, wine and cloth.

This difference can be seen at a glance.

"By the way." Lin Guoqiang spoke again, "There is one more thing."

Everyone at the table looked at him.

"Zhijun does a good job in my store."

Lin Guoqiang looked at Zhao Zhijun, who was sitting at the end of the table, "Willing to learn, willing to work, not lazy.

Starting next month, the salary will rise to 40 yuan."

Zhao Zhijun dropped his chopsticks.

"Four... forty?"

"Yes." Lin Guoqiang nodded, "Now you can take charge of your own business. You don't need me to keep an eye on you, kneading the dough, braised the meat, and watching the heat.

Worth the price."

Zhao Zhijun stood up, his face flushed: "Third brother-in-law, I..."
